name: [SOON] Project Viltrumites
desc:
a Battleground experience  - Project Viltrumites.

Fighting game with frequent content updates, suggest and give feedback in our server.

⭐ Upvote the game to show your support! ⭐ 

🖥️ PC basic controls.

F – Block
Q – Dash
Q (While ragdolled) - Evasive / Rc
Q (While flying) - Aereal boost
R – Fly
T – LockOn
V – Pick up objects/throw objects
LeftClick – Punch

Inspired by Invincible.

Mobile/Pc/Console supported.
